prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with a public function.
Required API: pub fn bounded_prefix_sum(values: &[i64], bound: i64) -> Option<i64>
Behavior: Return the exact sum only when every prefix sum, including the initial zero, remains within the inclusive symmetric bound. Reject a negative bound and return the failure value on arithmetic overflow.
Visible example: With bound 3, [3,-2] succeeds with 1, while [4,-4] fails because its first prefix exceeds the bound.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: pub fn bounded_prefix_sum(v:&[i64],b:i64)->Option<i64>{if b<0{return None}let mut x=0i64;for &n in v{x=x.checked_add(n)?;if x>b||x < -b{return None}}Some(x)}
